    for col, stats_dict in profile_results.items():
        row = {
            'Column': col,
            'Type': stats_dict['type'],
            'Count': stats_dict['count'],
            'Missing': stats_dict['missing'],
            'Missing %': f"{stats_dict['missing_pct']:.1f}%",
            'Unique': stats_dict.get('unique_values', 'N/A')
        }
        
        if stats_dict['type'] == 'numeric':

                'Min': f"{stats_dict['min']:.4f}",

            })

                'Mode %': f"{stats_dict['mode_pct']:.1f}%"
            })

                   bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))
        
        plot_idx += 1
    
    # Hide unused subplots
    for i in range(plot_idx, len(axes)):
        axes[i].set_visible(False)
